# Unit 3 integrated review — original formative practice
Try these optional questions at your own pace, or allow around 40 minutes as a pacing exercise. Try without notes if useful, then compare with the explained answers. Use the synthetic media-centre context and show your reasoning.

P1: Trace the workbook grid/alias/copy code; explain alias versus copied rows; explain why [[0,0]] * 2 is unsuitable for independent rows and give a repair.
P2: Give the final insertion-sort order by quantity for C03:2,C01:1,C02:2; explain stability here; justify whether ID binary search is valid on that result; repair the supplied search boundary and give a smallest revealing test with expected result.
P3: Explain inheritance and overriding for Camera/Projector Equipment subclasses; explain polymorphic label() calls; state and test the return-once stock invariant.
P4: For a rejection-message maintenance change, identify a requirement and version record; explain a meaningful regression test; identify one privacy/ethical/inclusive design responsibility and a concrete action.
N1: Host 192.168.50.70/27: mask, network, broadcast, ordinary host range, capacity, valid gateway candidate with caveat.
N2: With no NAT, explain IP destination and gateway MAC for a remote server; explain why separate VLANs alone do not enforce a guest restriction; choose the rule enforcement point on a diagram; name one required service dependency to preserve.
N3: Calculate demand for 20 clients at 8 Mbit/s, compare 100 Mbit/s, ideal equal share, ideal 400 MB transfer time at 100 Mbit/s, and one reason a 1 Gbit/s local upgrade may leave internet transfer limited.
N4: Unanswered intermediate traceroute hop followed by responding destination: observation, limited conclusion, plausible explanation, useful next test under teacher-approved lab conditions.
Use the explanations to choose what to revisit. Correct a misunderstanding and retry with fresh values.
